races.verdict: MEET ME IN MERAKI was the subject of a late gamble and may well have rewarded his backers had he seen daylight earlier when just touched off by reopposing Zambezi Magic at Chepstow 11 days ago. Condotti back at a more suitable trip and Chilly Breeze head up the dangers, with Ayr scorer West Tyrone and Risk Averse Rebel just another couple to factor in. MEET ME IN MERAKI CONDOTTI (IRE) CHILLY BREEZE

races.verdict: LADY GORMIRE had been held back by racing too freely but settled better when off the mark under a positive ride at Catterick 16 days ago. So Sassy won back-to-back handicaps on all-weather at Wolverhampton recently and is thriving but now switches to turf, whilst Sugar Sugar merits respect if she's in the mood. races.verdict: Sammy Jo Bell has a strong record in this race, with 3 wins since 2019, and ANTHROPOLOGIST might be able to provide her with another success. This 4-y-o has raced mainly on all-weather since joining Michael Herrington but won on turf during his time with Charlie Johnston. This trip could be on the limit of Caragio 's stamina but trainer-jockey Adam Kirby might have had this race in mind for him for a while and he's second choice ahead of Wield , the mount of recently retired Joe Fanning. ANTHROPOLOGIST CARAGIO (IRE) WIELD

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: THE DOTSKI shaped with definite promise in a pair of maiden hurdles during the second half of last season, paying for a big move into contention when fourth in a Navan maiden in February. Returning to action with her yard amongst the winners and open to further improvement, she shades preference over Willie Mullins' recent course runner-up Ronnie's Rascal and Brave Lady . THE DOTSKI (IRE) RONNIE'S RASCAL (IRE) BRAVE LADY (IRE)

races.verdict: IL SILENZIO has looked a much-improved performer since being sent chasing and did well to overcome a troubled passage when scoring at Roscommon last month. A 7 lb rise doesn’t look excessive and, with more to come, he makes plenty of appeal. Set The Tone shaped well last time and remains well treated on his hurdles form, so rates the main danger, while the progressive Ladies Well is another to consider.
